name: American Radio Archives (Thousand Oaks Library)
operator: Thousand Oaks Library Foundation / Special Collections

pricing.billingNote: Public municipal/foundation special collection; online exhibits free, physical holdings require Thousand Oaks, CA visit.
pricing.freeTierNote: ~3,200 digitized scripts, photos, and audio recordings online via Calisphere / library portal.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Personal papers, scripts, and 16" acetates of Norman Corwin, Carlton E. Morse, Rudy Vallée, and KNX/CBS Pacific Network
provenance.airdateMethodology: Original creator production scripts, studio timing sheets, and KNX master logs
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Archival finding aids & handwritten cast sheets on original studio scripts

specNotes.free_no_paywall: Only ~1,400 of 12,500 items digitized on Calisphere; remainder is physical scripts/discs in Thousand Oaks, CA.

primary_source_verification.summary: Primary studio production scripts and acetate labels straight from the estates of the writers and directors.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Sourced directly from the personal studio collections of Norman Corwin, Carlton E. Morse, and KNX/CBS Hollywood."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Handwritten studio cast call sheets on original rehearsal scripts identify even uncredited utility actors.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Original production scripts include studio penciled cast assignments and rehearsal timings."

vtt_transcripts.summary: Provides high-resolution PDF scans of original typewriter scripts, but no synchronized `.vtt` caption tracks.
vtt_transcripts.evidenceQuote: "Digitized holdings include PDF script scans rather than time-aligned WebVTT files."

master_provenance.summary: First-generation West Coast reference acetates and network line-check discs.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Preserves original 16-inch reference acetates cut directly at CBS Columbia Square Hollywood."

serial_continuity.summary: Holds complete consecutive script books for *One Man's Family* and *I Love a Mystery*.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Complete chronological Book and Chapter numbering for Carlton E. Morse serials."

open_api_export.summary: Indexed in Online Archive of California (OAC) and Calisphere APIs, but no unified OTR streaming endpoint.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Finding aids published via Online Archive of California (EAD XML) and Calisphere."

ad_free_playback.summary: Free and ad-free, but 89% of holdings require an in-person reading room appointment in Thousand Oaks, CA.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "Most physical audio discs and script boxes require an on-site appointment at the Grant R. Brimhall Library."

dedup_integrity.summary: Archival box/folder/item numbering uniquely identifies every physical disc and script.
dedup_integrity.evidenceQuote: "Standardized archival collection, series, box, and folder identifiers."

gotchas.title: 89% Non-Streamable Without Visiting Thousand Oaks, California
gotchas.detail: Primarily a physical special-collections reading room with a limited online digital exhibit footprint.
